annotations.title: Canada recalls & safety alerts (Health Canada, CFIA, Transport Canada)

description: Search Government of Canada recalls and safety alerts from official open data: food (CFIA), consumer products, health products, medical devices and vehicles. Filter by agency, category, recall class, issue, keyword and update-date range. Use it to check whether a product or brand was recalled in Canada, monitor new recalls, or support product-safety and compliance work. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/health-canada-recalls on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.003 per recall notice, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/health-canada-recalls

category.description: Category contains. e.g. Food, Car, Household items.

includeArchived.description: Include archived. Archived notices are excluded by default.

organization.description: Organization contains. e.g. CFIA, TC, Medical devices, Consumer product safety.

recallClass.description: Recall class contains. e.g. Class 1, Type II.

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).
